interview.location: 美国加利福尼亚州斯坦福大学斯坦福体育场
interview.occasion: 斯坦福大学第114届毕业典礼
interview.context: 2005年，乔布斯50岁，已回归苹果近八年，成功推出iMac、iPod和iTunes Store。他刚被诊断出患有胰腺癌并接受了手术。这场演讲以三个故事串联了他的人生哲学，被认为是史上最伟大的毕业演讲之一。

key_segments.text_en: The first story is about connecting the dots.
key_segments.text_zh: 第一个故事，关于串联生命中的点滴。

key_segments.text_en: I dropped out of Reed College after the first 6 months, but then stayed around as a drop-in for another 18 months or so before I really quit... The minute I dropped out I could stop taking the required classes that didn't interest me, and begin dropping in on the ones that looked interesting.
key_segments.text_zh: 我在里德学院只读了六个月就退学了，但之后作为旁听生又待了大约十八个月才真正离开……退学的那一刻，我不再需要上那些我不感兴趣的必修课，而是可以去旁听那些看起来有趣的课程。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 逆向思维 / 信任直觉

key_segments.text_en: Reed College at that time offered perhaps the best calligraphy instruction in the country... None of this had even a hope of any practical application in my life. But ten years later, when we were designing the first Macintosh computer, it all came back to me.
key_segments.text_zh: 里德学院当时提供了也许是全美最好的书法课程……这些在当时看来没有任何实际应用的可能。但十年后，当我们在设计第一台Macintosh电脑时，这一切都回到了我脑海中。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 连接思维 / 长期主义

key_segments.text_en: You can't connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backwards. So you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect in your future. You have to trust in something — your gut, destiny, life, karma, whatever. This approach has never let me down, and it has made all the difference in my life.
key_segments.text_zh: 你不可能向前看时就把这些点串联起来；你只能在回头看的时候才能把它们串联起来。所以你必须相信，这些点在你未来的某一天会以某种方式连接起来。你必须相信某些东西——你的直觉、命运、生命、因果，无论什么。这种做法从来没有让我失望过，它让我的人生变得截然不同。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 直觉思维 / 信仰驱动

key_segments.text_en: My second story is about love and loss... And then I got fired. How can you get fired from a company you started? ... So at 30, I was out. And very publicly out. What had been the focus of my entire adult life was gone, and it was devastating.
key_segments.text_zh: 我的第二个故事，关于爱与失去……然后我被解雇了。你怎么可能被自己创办的公司解雇呢？……所以在30岁那年，我出局了。而且是公开地出局。我整个成年生活的重心突然消失了，这简直是毁灭性的打击。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 韧性思维 / 成长型思维

key_segments.text_en: I didn't see it then, but it turned out that getting fired from Apple was the best thing that could have ever happened to me... Sometimes life hits you in the head with a brick. Don't lose faith... The only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle.
key_segments.text_zh: 我当时没有意识到，但事实证明，被苹果解雇是我人生中发生的最好的事情……有时候生活会用砖头砸你的头。不要失去信念……做伟大工作的唯一方式就是热爱你所做的事。如果你还没有找到，继续寻找。不要将就。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 热爱驱动 / 韧性思维

key_segments.text_en: My third story is about death... Remembering that you are going to die is the best way I know to avoid the trap of thinking you have something to lose. You are already naked. There is no reason not to follow your heart.
key_segments.text_zh: 我的第三个故事，关于死亡……记住你终将死去，这是我所知道的避免陷入'你有什么可以失去'这个陷阱的最好方法。你已经赤身裸体了。没有理由不追随你的内心。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 死亡意识 / 存在主义

key_segments.text_en: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life. Don't be trapped by dogma — which is living with the results of other people's thinking. Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice. And most important, have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
key_segments.text_zh: 你的时间是有限的，所以不要浪费时间去过别人的生活。不要被教条所困——也就是按照别人思考的结果去生活。不要让他人意见的噪音淹没了你自己内心的声音。最重要的是，要有勇气追随你的内心和直觉。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 自我觉醒 / 独立思考

key_segments.text_en: About a year ago I was diagnosed with cancer... I had the surgery and thankfully I'm fine now.
key_segments.text_zh: 大约一年前，我被诊断出患有癌症……我做了手术，谢天谢地，我现在很好。

key_segments.text_en: Death is very likely the single best invention of Life. It is Life's change agent. It clears out the old to make way for the new.
key_segments.text_zh: 死亡很可能是生命最好的发明。它是生命变革的推动者。它清除旧的，为新的让路。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 哲学思辨 / 变革思维
